scope: Read-only audit of the already-downloaded R4 terminal ERROR attempt and its generic complete consumer. No provider call, download, fit, push, or score was performed.

checks.root_admission_and_status_validation: pass; exact admitted action/kernel/ERROR snapshot and collection path validated
checks.root_request_ownership: pass; generic receipt binds the exact terminal-download admission and root push; diagnostics bind admission, predownload inventory, root fit dispatch, and push
checks.fresh_provider_inventory: pass; complete unique 108-name `list_kernel_session_output` inventory exactly matches the reviewed predownload names; its response-log SHA/size equals the predownload metadata
checks.generic_complete_consumer: pass; reviewed adapter `collection_is_complete` and `terminal_evidence_complete` both returned true
checks.downloaded_provider_outputs: pass; 108 provider names exactly equal local outputs excluding the one CLI-generated response log
checks.downloaded_hash_closure: pass; all 115 generic-receipt file records (1,447,882 bytes total) matched current local files by size and SHA-256; no missing or changed file
checks.response_log: pass; downloaded 19,047-byte runner log SHA matched the fresh and predownload response-log metadata
checks.fit_and_prediction_artifacts: none; provider inventory and downloaded output contain zero `.npy`, `.pt`, `.pth`, or `.ckpt` files; diagnostics report no fit/export stage started and empty fit/prediction artifact lists
checks.error_interpretation: pass; provider status is `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR`, strict science validation is `not_run_terminal_error`, and the diagnostic says infrastructure reservation failure after paired profiling; this is execution evidence, not a scientific model failure

limits: Kaggle's endpoint exposed no per-file remote sizes or content hashes and did not pin the API response to a version. The review establishes exact admitted request ownership, stable filename inventory, fresh-response-log equality, local byte hashes, and generic-consumer completeness; it does not claim remote content-hash identity or scientific fit/export success.
independent_verification: Revalidated frozen R4 bindings and root admission with the collector; loaded the pinned R2 adapter, called its read-only generic completion and inventory-comparison consumers, recomputed all 115 local file hashes, and matched the source-binding receipt. All checks ran with the requested 50% CPU, one thread, 700 MB, and 120-second support cap.
